apps.name: Study Timer
apps.tagline: Pomodoro timer that keeps you focused during long study sessions.
apps.description: A simple Pomodoro timer with configurable focus and break intervals, plus a running streak counter.
apps.purpose: To help students build a daily study habit and stop procrastinating by breaking work into small sessions.
apps.target: Students who struggle to focus while studying at home.
apps.howItWorks: Pick focus and break lengths, hit start, and the timer cycles automatically. Sessions completed today are counted and streaks are saved locally.
apps.author: Juan Dela Cruz

apps.name: Campus Events
apps.tagline: One place for every org event, club meeting, and school deadline.
apps.description: A weekly calendar of on-campus events pulled together from org pages and bulletin boards.
apps.purpose: To stop students from missing events because announcements are scattered across different pages and groups.
apps.target: Students and org officers who need a single view of the school calendar.
apps.howItWorks: Events are added by org officers, tagged by category, and shown in a week-by-week calendar with a one-tap 'Add to calendar' action.
apps.author: Maria Santos

apps.name: Grade Saver
apps.tagline: Estimate the grade you need to pass before the next exam.
apps.description: Enter your current scores and the upcoming exam weight to see exactly what you need to hit a passing grade.
apps.purpose: To remove the guesswork around finals week and help students plan their review time.
apps.target: Students in their last weeks of a semester.
apps.howItWorks: You log each graded item and its weight. The app computes your running average and works backwards to tell you the minimum score required to pass.
apps.author: Carlos Reyes
